quests.title: Manly Jack's Manly Journey of Manliness

dialogue.sit: I heard you're in need of Chicken-Mushroom Skewers...

dialogue.t: Yeah, I am. You saw my commission, eh?
Thanks for coming over to help me out. So, do you have those three Chicken-Mushroom Skewers?
Wow, smells good. I'll take them.
These are for you. Thanks for the help!
Now, watch me eat all these in one go...

quests.description: Manly Jack needs three Chicken-Mushroom Skewers.
